evals.prompt: Two affiliate sites got access to our projections last month and neither has shipped anything. Help them build.
evals.expected_output: A starter kit with a first-build target, owners, a contact and exit terms.
expectations: Sets a first-build target in one sentence with a time target
Lists kit items such as a guide, a sample and test data, each marked exists or to make with an owner
Names one contact with a reply time
Keeps samples free of live keys and member data

evals.prompt: Before the first outside modeler starts on our NCAAF data, what developer docs and sample code do we need?
evals.expected_output: A kit plan that keeps the builder's way out and routes publishing through release.
expectations: Names the smallest first build a modeler should get working
Uses standard formats such as CSV or JSON
Strikes or rules out any term that ties the builder's work to the company only
Routes publishing the guide or any endpoint through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's word
